name: GFM
recent: GFM 近期持续进行股份回购，董事兼大股东 Ruslan bin Nordin 在 9 月和 10 月两度增持共 200 万股。公司旗下单位在 Pengerang Integrated Complex 的 release order 价值获上调 56% 至 RM104.2mil，使总额增至 RM269mil。公司已于 8 月公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
notable: 公司旗下单位在 Pengerang Integrated Complex 的 release order 价值上调 56% 至 RM104.2mil，总额增至 RM269mil。

董事兼大股东 Ruslan bin Nordin 于 2026 年 9 月 11 日及 10 月 12 日各增持 100 万股。

news.title: GFM records 56% upward revision in release order value
GFM unit's release order value revised to RM104.2mil for Pengerang Integrated Complex
GFM unit secured 56 per cent higher order for Pengerang Integrated Complex, increased total to RM269mil
Foodie Media partners Tourism Malaysia to promote Visit Malaysia 2026-2027 campaign

recent_en: GFM has been actively buying back its own shares, while Director and substantial shareholder Ruslan bin Nordin acquired a total of 2 million shares in September and October. The release order value for its unit at Pengerang Integrated Complex was revised upward by 56% to RM104.2mil, raising the total to RM269mil. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 in August.
notable_en: The release order value for the company's unit at Pengerang Integrated Complex was revised upward by 56% to RM104.2mil, bringing the total to RM269mil.
Director and substantial shareholder Ruslan bin Nordin acquired 1 million shares each on 11 September and 12 October 2026.
